description: Paragraph 0241 grammatical behavior. Root rules bind to authoritative entry IDs; examples are approved complete surface forms. Specific printed derivatives remain exact-form exceptions.

default_behaviour.note: Applies to every dictionary entry without an explicit rule below.

document_policies.source: ABBREVIATIONS AND SYMBOLS.docx; Paragraph 0241 and Section 1610
document_policies.personnel_line: authorized leading rank; initials without full stops; suffixes separated by commas
document_policies.consistent_abbreviations: same approved form within each conversion

tokenization.source_notation_expansion: Parenthetical endings and slash-delimited alternatives are normalized into match_variants before indexing.

morphology.rule: Apply declared examples and controlled grammatical rules only to authorized dictionary roots, respecting exact-form exceptions and complete word boundaries. Paragraph 0241 authorizes verb derivatives and composed forms; specific published exceptions take precedence.

conversion_pipeline.rule: Normalize Unicode apostrophes and repeated spaces while retaining original punctuation offsets.
Temporarily mask already-valid abbreviations and protected spans such as URLs, email addresses, decimals and date/time groups.
At each cursor position test every authorized match_variants value for enabled entries in longest-phrase-first order.
Replace only complete phrases at word boundaries; retain adjacent punctuation and possessive endings.
Forward conversion uses the exact full phrase. Reverse conversion must use selected service/category/context or ask the user; never guess.
Apply acting/assistant/deputy/officiating/vice and national-force formatting rules after phrase replacement.
Restore protected spans and original punctuation.
Return unresolved or ambiguous terms separately for review.

context_rules.action: Use prefix D; use Dy where D could be confused

example.input: Deputy Assistant Director of Ordnance Services

context_rules.action: Use V in the authorized title
Put the national distinguishing letters in parentheses immediately after the force, formation or unit number

context_rules.trigger: army element smaller than a division
context_rules.action: Add national letters only when needed to avoid confusion

context_rules.trigger: qualification letters referring to the qualification rather than the institution
context_rules.action: Use lower-case qualification form where prescribed
Exclude from the general converter unless signal-message mode is explicitly enabled

scope_rules: Prefer clarity over brevity; do not convert when the result would be unclear.
Do not automatically use Service abbreviations for foreign, non-service or civilian addressees.
Where one abbreviation has multiple meanings, forward conversion is allowed only from an exact full phrase; reverse conversion requires context or user selection.
Keep standard English abbreviations such as e.g., i.e., etc., am, pm, RSVP, SOS, BA, BSc, Mr. and Mrs. unchanged unless a dedicated style mode says otherwise.
Units of measurement belong to the separate Section 2 list and are outside this dataset.

rules.source_rule: Reviewer-approved exact conversion; plural treatment follows 0241
